title: Social Media Growth Operator / Face-of-Brand Content Creator for AI Trucking Safety Startup
description:
About the Role



Fleetmule is a fast-growing startup helping small and mid-sized trucking companies stay compliant with FMCSA and DOT safety requirements using AI, automation, and hands-on compliance support.



We are looking for a Social Media Growth Operator / Content Creator to help us become the most visible AI trucking safety brand online.



This is not a “make pretty graphics” role.



We need someone who can create short-form videos, write strong hooks, actively comment on trucking-related conversations, engage with carriers, dispatchers, owner-operators, and safety managers, and help turn social media attention into real leads.



The right person may also become the face of the brand on video — recording talking-head clips, reacting to trucking safety issues, explaining DOT/FMCSA problems in simple language, and creating content that feels real, useful, and direct.



What You’ll Do



You will own day-to-day social media activity across platforms such as Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn, and
.



Responsibilities include:



Create short-form video ideas, scripts, hooks, captions, and posts

Record talking-head videos yourself when needed

Edit or coordinate simple video edits with subtitles, B-roll, screenshots, and trucking-related visuals

Comment daily on trucking, DOT, FMCSA, compliance, safety, freight, dispatch, and owner-operator content

Engage with trucking communities, pages, groups, creators, and prospects

Turn Fleetmule’s expertise into educational, viral, and lead-generating content

Respond to comments and DMs using approved scripts

Track which posts, hooks, comments, and topics generate attention and leads

Test different content angles: fear-based compliance warnings, education, humor, founder-style opinions, industry news, and case-study content

Help build a repeatable weekly content system



Examples of Content Topics



“Your DOT audit problem probably started 6 months ago”

“Why small carriers lose authority without realizing it”

“FMCSA letters trucking owners should never ignore”

“The hidden cost of bad driver qualification files”

“What owner-operators get wrong about safety compliance”

“AI tools for trucking compliance and safety”

“Real stories from carriers who ignored safety problems too long”



Who We’re Looking For



You should be someone who is comfortable being active online every day. You do not need to know everything about trucking on day one, but you must be willing to learn fast.



Ideal candidate:



Strong short-form video instincts

Comfortable on camera or willing to become comfortable

Excellent written English

Understands TikTok/Reels/Shorts style content

Knows how to write strong hooks and captions

Can comment naturally without sounding like spam

Can research trucking industry topics

Can create content that feels human, direct, and useful

Has good judgment and can represent a serious B2B brand

Is proactive and does not wait for instructions every day



Bonus Points



Experience with trucking, logistics, freight, dispatch, safety, DOT, FMCSA, or compliance

Experience growing B2B social media accounts

Experience creating founder-led or face-of-brand content

Experience with CapCut, Canva, Descript, Premiere, or similar tools

Experience with LinkedIn growth,
/X, Reddit,
 Groups, or TikTok community engagement

Experience turning comments and DMs into leads



What Success Looks Like



In the first 30–60 days, success means:



3–5 short-form videos published per week

Daily comments on relevant trucking conversations

More profile visits, followers, comments, and DMs

Clear testing of different hooks and topics

A repeatable content calendar

Qualified trucking leads coming from social media activity

Why Join Us

• Competitive compensation aligned with top Philippine market rates

• Remote-first culture with flexible working arrangements

• Opportunities for career growth and exposure to international clients

• Be part of a supportive, respectful, and high-performing team



HOW TO APPLY



Application Link: 



As part of our standard recruitment procedure, we kindly ask that you complete your application through Rippling, our global Human Resources Information System (HRIS). This platform is used globally at DTiQ to ensure a consistent and secure way of managing candidate information.



What to expect:

We understand that this process may be different from traditional application methods commonly used in the Philippines, such as submitting resumes via
 or by job postings. Our HRIS system will require you to:

• Create a profile with a username and password for you to access throughout the recruiting process and if hired, it will be used for timekeeping and payroll.

• Re-enter details already included in your resume (this helps us standardize globally). We recognize this may seem repetitive but it ensures your profile is properly integrated into our global system which is necessary to schedule interviews and onboard.

• Upload supporting documents such as your CV.



Once your profile is complete in Rippling, we’ll begin to schedule interviews with qualified candidates. The interview will last up to an hour and may include 1-2 people (the direct hiring manager and potentially a department lead).



Hired candidates will be engaged through an Employment of Record (EOR) at the start of employment. This is a widely used approach by international companies to hire talent in countries where we do not yet have a legal entity and allows us to comply with legal regulations. This means that Rippling, our EOR provider in the Philippines will officially employ you on behalf of DTiQ Technologies while you will work day-to-day with our team. Under this arrangement salary, government contributions and taxes are processed in compliance with Philippine regulations. DTiQ will manage your daily work, performance and career development. If you have further questions about this arrangement, please let me know and I’d be happy to address it with you.



Is my data secure?

Yes, the system complies with international data privacy standards and your information will only be accessed by authorized personnel.



What if I experience technical issues?

If you have any trouble in the Rippling system, please reply to this message so we can assist you properly.



We truly appreciate your time and effort in completing these next steps. If you have any questions or concerns, please reach out – I’m here to help.



At DTiQ, we value dedication, teamwork, and continuous improvement. If you are looking for a stable job with opportunities to grow and develop your skills, we encourage you to apply and be part of our global team.

title: AI UGC Creator + Social Media Operator — 10 Videos/Day | Full-Time Remote | $3,000 Growth Bonus
description:
AI UGC Creator + Social Media Operator — 10 Videos/Day | Full-Time Remote | $3,000 Growth Bonus



TL;DR — for skimmers



• The role: Make 10 short-form videos/day. Post to brand-new TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube accounts. Grow them from zero.

• Pay: $1,600 USD/month + up to $3,000 bonus — $1,000 per platform that hits 1,000 followers.

• Hard requirements: Own a Mac. Own an iPhone. Use iMessage actively. Strong video editing skills. Experience with AI tools.

• Tools: Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut Pro, Higgsfield / HeyGen / ElevenLabs, Buffer / Later / Metricool, or similar.

• Schedule: 5 days OR 7 days/week — your choice. Batch production is fine. 10 videos must auto-post every single day.

• What makes this different: You also manage the accounts. Closed-loop role: create ? post ? measure ? iterate.

• To apply: Send a 30-second sample video featuring real Mac screen-recording footage. Full requirements below.



------------------------------------------------------------



ABOUT US



We're an independently distributed Mac app in the relationship / communication space.



The product plugs into iMessage and helps people understand their texts — what they really mean, what changed, and what's going on between them.



The app name and website will be shared after we review your application.



We're launching from scratch on social. You'll inherit three brand-new accounts with ZERO followers — TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube — and your job is to grow them.



You will produce 10 short-form videos per day, schedule them across all three platforms using automation tools, watch the data, and iterate.



This is a closed-loop creator role:



Make ? Schedule ? Watch Metrics ? Make More Of What Works ? Repeat



Big upside: every platform you grow to 1,000 followers earns you a $1,000 bonus on top of your base. All three = $3,000 bonus.



------------------------------------------------------------



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Creation — the bulk of your day



• Produce 10 vertical 9:16 short-form videos per day, 30–60 seconds each.

• Use AI avatar / generation tools like Higgsfield, HeyGen, Synthesia, Captions.ai, or similar to generate creator-style videos.

• Use ElevenLabs or comparable tools for voiceover.

• Use our Mac app on YOUR Mac and screen-record yourself using the app on YOUR real iMessage threads.

• Combine AI footage + Mac demo footage in Premiere Pro, After Effects, or CapCut Pro.

• Add captions, hooks, on-screen text, and CTAs.

• Create relationship/dating/life-situation story videos that feel native to TikTok, Reels, and Shorts.



The goal is not polished corporate content.



The goal is high-volume, emotionally specific, scroll-stopping short-form content.

------------------------------------------------------------



DISTRIBUTION



You will use automation tools like Buffer, Later, Metricool, Publer, or similar to schedule and cross-post videos across:



• TikTok

• Instagram Reels

• YouTube Shorts



10 posts/day must go out every day, regardless of whether you're working that day.



You can queue however far ahead you want.



You will also:



• Write platform-specific captions

• Add hashtags

• Add pinned comments

• Track which posts perform

• Respond to basic comments

• Keep the posting queue full



The automation queue can NEVER run dry.



------------------------------------------------------------



ITERATION



This is not just a video editing job.



You are responsible for noticing what works and making more of it.



You will watch the metrics in TikTok Creator Center, Instagram Insights, and YouTube Studio:



• Views

• Watch time

• Completion rate

• Shares

• Saves

• Comments

• Click-throughs

• Trial signups, when available



Then you will adjust the next batch of videos based on the data.



If a hook works, make 10 more variations.



If a format dies, kill it.



If one story angle gets comments, lean into it.



The job is:



Create ? Post ? Measure ? Learn ? Create Better



------------------------------------------------------------



REQUIREMENTS



• You must own a Mac — MacBook or Mac desktop.

• You must own an iPhone and actively use iMessage.

• Android users — please don't apply.

• You must be comfortable screen-recording your Mac.

• You must be comfortable using real iMessage threads for product demos. You can blur names, numbers, and private details.

• Strong short-form video editing skills.

• Experience making TikToks, Reels, Shorts, UGC, social ads, or AI-generated videos.

• Experience with AI video / avatar / voiceover tools.

• Comfortable making high-volume content.

• Comfortable looking at metrics and changing direction based on performance.

• Strong English for captions, hooks, CTAs, and comments.

• Reliable queue management. 10 videos must post every day, including weekends and days off.

• Stable internet.

• Available on Google Chat from 8 PM – 10 PM US Eastern on your work days for syncs and quick feedback.



------------------------------------------------------------



NICE TO HAVE



• Experience growing a TikTok, Instagram, or YouTube account from zero.

• Experience producing relationship, dating, lifestyle, or story-based content.

• Experience marketing Apple/Mac products.

• Experience with motion graphics or kinetic typography.

• Experience with social media scheduling tools.

• Familiarity with TikTok Creator Center, Instagram Insights, and YouTube Studio.

• Familiarity with affiliate links, UTM links, or performance tracking.



------------------------------------------------------------



WHAT WE PAY



• Base: $1,600 USD/month, paid weekly via PayPal.

• Growth bonus: $1,000 per platform that reaches 1,000 followers.

• Platforms: TikTok, Instagram, YouTube.

• All three platforms reaching 1,000 followers = $3,000 total bonus.

• Bonus is paid immediately when each platform crosses the threshold.

------------------------------------------------------------



HOURS



You d
 how you want to work.



What matters is the output:



10 videos posted automatically per day, every day, across all three platforms.



We don't measure hours logged.



We measure:



1. Quality of the 10 daily posts

2. Consistency of posting

3. Growth toward the 1K follower bonus thresholds

4. Whether you are learning from the metrics

5. Whether winning content leads to more winning content



------------------------------------------------------------



HOW TO APPLY



Reply with:



1. Confirm you own a Mac.

Include model/year if you know it.



2. Confirm you own an iPhone and actively use iMessage.

Android users — please don't apply.



3. Send 3–5 examples of short-form videos you've edited or created.

TikTok, Reels, Shorts, UGC, AI videos, or social ads are all fine.



4. Tell us which tools you use.

Include editing tools, AI video tools, voiceover tools, and scheduling tools.



5. Send ONE 30-second sample video.



Imagine a fictional Mac app that reads your iMessage history and helps you understand what someone really means over text.



Make a UGC-style short selling that fictional app.



The video should include:



• A real Mac on screen OR a Mac screen recording

• A relationship-style hook

• A quick explanation of what the app does

• Captions or on-screen text

• A clear CTA to try/download the app



Use this hook:



“She stopped replying for 2 days. I opened this Mac app to figure out what changed.”



Use this CTA:



“Try it on your Mac.”



Any Mac app is fine for the screen recording sample — Notes, Messages, Safari, anything. We just need to see that you can make a believable Mac-based UGC video with a hook, story, and CTA.



------------------------------------------------------------



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR — HONESTLY



We want someone who can make a lot of short-form videos, learn from the numbers, and keep improving.



You do not need to be famous.



You do not need a huge personal account.



But you do need taste, speed, consistency, and the ability to spot what people actually watch.



We want someone who is close to our target customer:



A Mac and iPhone user with real relationships, real iMessage threads, and an understanding of why people overthink texts.



If you read this and think, “I can absolutely grow these accounts from zero” — apply.



If you'd rather just edit videos and let someone else worry about growth, this probably isn't your role.
